gallery.description: Karla Caves Great Chaitya Left pillar No9. This pillar was donated by a Yavana circa 120 CE, like five other pillars. The inscription of this pillar reads: "dhenukākaṭa yavanasa | yasavadhanānaṃ | thabo danaṃ" i.e. "(This) pillar (is) the gift of the Yavana Yasavadhana from Denukakata".[1] Below: detail of the word "Yavanasa" (, adjectival form of "Yavana", old Brahmi script).
